resolved_findings.issue: Nested feature contracts and tool cache TTLs were forwarded without exhaustive supported-field/value validation. Unknown message/content fields also passed.
resolved_findings.resolution: Strict nested/content/message and cache TTL allowlists added; TestUnknownNestedFeaturesNeverReserveOrForward passes with zero exposure/sends.

resolved_findings.issue: Private Cloud Run transport relied on a single authenticating Authorization header while application performs independent JWT validation.
resolved_findings.resolution: Paired X-Serverless-Authorization and Authorization headers preserve application-verifiable token; all CLI, admission, release and Claude child paths assert the contract. Live token behavior still requires nonbillable canary preflight.

resolved_findings.issue: Admitted concurrency slots were never released on completed jobs or known failures before launch.
resolved_findings.resolution: Attempt-scoped release route/authority, known rejected-launch cleanup and outer execute-job defer implemented; stale attempt cannot release newer lease; money remains reserved.

resolved_findings.issue: Successful gateway release HTTP 204 was initially treated as failure by client expecting 200.
resolved_findings.resolution: Client accepts 204/200; authenticated scoped release regression passes.

resolved_findings.issue: Initial Cloud Run service timeout was shorter than supported upstream request deadline.
resolved_findings.resolution: Service timeout now 660s, matching ten-minute request plus settlement/cleanup headroom.

resolved_findings.issue: Installed CLI2.1.295 mandatory beta headers prevented every guarded request in round 1.
resolved_findings.resolution: User-approved bounded continuation forces the inspected client proxy-compatibility switch, omitting beta extensions before sending. Gateway allowlist was not expanded. Actual CLI completion and two-request Bash printf loop pass under race, separately reserve/settle requests and leave no reservation. Live deployed image remains an activation gate.

activation_blockers: Verified Anthropic organization/workspace, stable grant/cycle reference, grant start and precise expiry/timezone/provider cap/allocation evidence remain outstanding. User confirmed $200 available and expiry date; conservative cutoff remains 2026-10-28T00:00:00Z.

Private credit authority, gateway and dedicated guarded jobs are not provisioned/deployed. Review and verify immutable source-release image digests, the reviewed CLI artifact/version and infrastructure release integration before enabling any canary.

Broad runtime and inherited folder secret-reader IAM grants remain documented. Scoped IAM change and isolated authority deployment require review and read-only verification; executors/coordinators must not obtain provider key or direct ledger-write authority.
Live paired Google token transport, actual deployed executor protocol, aggregate reserved $5 canary, Anthropic billing-category reconciliation and rollback observations have not run.
Required CI on the final PR head is pending. This report uses final supplied local gates; it does not substitute them for the required PR CI.
